你是课程页重规划器。质量门已证明当前页靠原 block 类型无法修好；请只重做这一页的骨架。
输出 JSON：{"scene":{完整 scene 骨架}}，不要解释。硬约束：
- scene id/kind 不变；保留同一教学位置，但可改 headline/lead/brief/notes 和 block 组合。
- blocks 只含 id/type/role/intent/size/可选 engine，不写最终内容；id 全局唯一。
- 每页一个可观察 objective、一个 keyClaim；标题写清所有必要前提。
- 二维曲面/等高线/几何轨迹用 sim + engine=widget；普通 graph/diagram 只表达概念关系，不能冒充坐标。
- 定量曲线必须由页面给出的公式直接计算，或清楚标为合成示意；不能用随手编的点冒充数学定义。
- 若现有 objective 本身要求一页塞两件事，可收窄目标；不要增加页数。

{"topic": "Gradient Descent and Learning Rate", "audience": "", "referenceMaterial": "[none provided]", "allowedTypes": {"chart": "Author a chart block for a LectureDoc lecture — a data chart (bar/line/area/scatter) rendered via Observable Plot, theme-aware. Reach for it whenever a page shows numeric comparison, trend over time, share/composition, or correlation — anything where seeing the shape of the numbers beats reading them. Prefer a chart over a table when magnitude/trend/relationship is the point; use a table only for exact nominal lookup where values are not being compared. Produces schema-valid chart block JSON.", "runnable": "Author a runnable (edit → Run) code cell block for a LectureDoc lecture — an in-browser Python (Pyodide) + JavaScript editor with a console and a result chart. Use a plain `code` block instead for read-only display the student will not run. Reach for it only after checking the structured types: graph covers trees, DAGs and branching flowcharts; chart covers data; diagram covers fixed shapes; grid and sim.widget cover custom layouts and interactive pieces. Produces schema-valid freeform block JSON.", "stats": "Author stats (KPI number cards), diagram (fixed structural shapes — cycle/pyramid/staircase/snake/arrow-seq/circular-grid/connected-circles) and graph (true node-edge trees, DAGs and branching flowcharts, rendered as real layered SVG) blocks for a LectureDoc lecture. Reach for stats to spotlight a handful of standalone key numbers; reach for graph whenever nodes have *named relationships* — parent/child, dependency, branch, merge — since it is the only block type with an edges field; reach for diagram only for a fixed decorative shape with no explicit edges. Reach for it whenever a page should check understanding or provoke reflection rather than only present — at least one per lecture is encouraged. Objective for a checkable fact/skill, subjective for open-ended thinking. Produces schema-valid quiz block JSON.", "sim": "Author a sim (simulation) block for a LectureDoc lecture — a parameter-driven interactive that recomputes and redraws in-browser as the student changes inputs. Reach for it whenever a quantitative or mechanistic process becomes clearer by letting the student turn a knob and watch the outcome change (physics/chem dynamics, algorithm behaviour, parameter sensitivity); pick a sim over a static chart when the interaction itself is the teaching point. Engines are chosen at build time: dynamics1d/searchCompare (declarative restricted-expression math → line charts), custom (sandboxed compute), widget (live canvas/SVG animation, geometric construction, or arbitrary mouse interaction). Skip it when the topic has no quantifiable/mechanistic process to manipulate — a sim with no real parameter to turn is decoration, not interaction. Produces schema-valid sim block JSON."}, "currentBrief": {"objective": "学生能写出梯度下降的迭代公式，并解释凸函数下 O(1/T) 收敛率的意义。", "keyClaim": "梯度下降在凸函数上以 O(1/T) 速率收敛到全局最优，在强凸函数上线性收敛。", "misconception": "认为梯度下降在任何函数上都保证收敛到全局最优。", "visualTask": "展示凸函数与非凸函数下梯度下降路径的对比，突出收敛行为差异。", "evidencePolicy": "synthetic"}, "currentScene": {"id": "mathematics", "kind": "content", "eyebrow": "数学形式", "headline": "凸函数与强凸函数下的收敛保证", "lead": "在适当步长下，梯度下降在凸函数上以 O(1/T) 收敛，在强凸函数上线性收敛。", "notes": "给出梯度下降的精确数学定义，并介绍凸函数下的收敛性质。", "blocks": [{"type": "formula", "latex": "x_{t+1} = x_t - \\eta \\nabla f(x_t)", "caption": "梯度下降迭代更新公式，其中 $\\eta$ 为学习率，$\\nabla f(x_t)$ 为梯度。", "id": "b_math_formula"}, {"type": "compare", "left": {"caption": "凸函数", "block": {"type": "callout", "label": "收敛保证", "text": "梯度下降路径直接指向全局最小值。函数值单调递减，收敛率 $O(1/T)$。"}}, "right": {"caption": "非凸函数", "block": {"type": "callout", "label": "收敛风险", "text": "梯度下降路径可能陷入局部最小值或鞍点。收敛到全局最优无保证，仅保证收敛到稳定点。"}}, "id": "b_math_compare"}, {"type": "list", "items": [{"lead": "凸函数", "text": "在递减步长 $η_t = O(1/t)$ 下，梯度下降以 $O(1/T)$ 速率收敛：$f(x_T) - f(x^*) ≤ O(1/T)$。", "icon": "trending-down"}, {"lead": "强凸函数", "text": "在固定步长 $η < 2/μ$（$μ$ 为强凸系数）下，梯度下降线性收敛：$f(x_T) - f(x^*) ≤ O(ρ^T)$，其中 $ρ < 1$。", "icon": "trending-down"}], "id": "b_math_list"}], "layout": {"kind": "compose", "areas": [{"blockIds": ["b_math_formula"], "col": [1, 7]}, {"blockIds": ["b_math_compare"], "col": [1, 9]}, {"blockIds": ["b_math_list"], "col": [9, 13]}]}}, "qualityIssues": ["视觉语义不满足：visualTask要求展示凸函数与非凸函数下梯度下降路径的对比，但当前页面仅有文字描述，没有实际路径图或动画。需要添加图表（如曲线图或动画）来直观展示路径差异。这可能需要增加新的block（如chart）或修改compare block以包含图形。", "布局重叠：b_math_formula的col范围[1,7]与b_math_compare的col范围[1,9]重叠，可能导致显示错乱。需要调整布局，例如将b_math_formula放在顶部跨列，b_math_compare和b_math_list左右并排且不重叠。", "左边callout文本不准确：'梯度下降路径直接指向全局最小值' 过于简化，实际路径不一定直接指向；'函数值单调递减' 缺少步长条件；'收敛率 O(1/T)' 未提及所需步长条件（如递减步长或固定小步长），与b_math_list中凸函数项的条件不一致，可能误导学生认为任何步长下都O(1/T)收敛。；修改左边callout文本，例如：'在适当步长（如递减步长 η_t=O(1/t)）下，梯度下降收敛到全局最小值，函数值单调递减，收敛率 O(1/T)。' 或与b_math_list凸函数项保持一致，明确步长条件。", "强凸函数项中步长条件 'η < 2/μ' 不准确。对于一般强凸函数，需要额外假设梯度Lipschitz连续（L-smooth），且步长通常需满足 η < 2/(L+μ) 或 η < 2/L 才能保证线性收敛。仅 η < 2/μ 可能过大导致发散。；修改强凸函数项文本，例如：'在固定步长 η < 2/(L+μ)（其中 L 为梯度Lipschitz常数，μ 为强凸系数）下，梯度下降线性收敛：f(x_T)-f(x^*) ≤ O(ρ^T)，ρ<1。' 或至少添加 '假设梯度Lipschitz连续' 并修正步长条件。", "凸函数项仅提及递减步长 η_t=O(1/t)，但未提及其他常见条件（如固定步长 η=1/L 也可得 O(1/T) 收敛），且未提及梯度Lipschitz假设，可能不完整。；可补充说明 '在梯度Lipschitz连续假设下，固定步长 η=1/L 也可得 O(1/T) 收敛'，或至少添加 '假设梯度Lipschitz连续'。"]}
